conservative.requirements: 7 favour. You must prominently display a symbol of your faith. Effect: Your symbol of faith stands as an inspiration to all of Sigmar’s faithful. While his blessing is recharging, all allies who can clearly see your symbol may recover 1 normal wound whenever they inflict one or more wounds on an enemy.
conservative.name: Mark of Zealous Faith
